networks.name: brief_desk
networks.description: Ask for a passage from a published knowledge node; the assistant finds it, checks it against its published digest, and can add it to your brief.
sample_queries: What is a Bundle? Answer from a passage and give its address.
Find a passage on how a digest in the discovery document is checked, and add it to my brief.
Ask the Standards Map what it offers on robots.txt and AI usage preferences.
Add the passage that defines a Cluster to my brief, then discard the brief.
Publish a new item on this node for me.

peer_policy.note: Local agents and page-local actions, and the partner sites in allowed_peers, each after the visitor agrees.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
